en: to go to see; to visit (on purpose)

examples.en: May I come by your office tomorrow?
Next week I'm going to go see my professor.

examples.ko: 친구 집에 찾아갈까요? — 네, 같이 가요.
examples.en: Shall we go and visit my friend? — Yes, let's go together.

examples.ko: 휴대폰이 고장 났어요. 서비스 센터에 찾아가야 해요.
examples.en: My phone is broken. I have to go to the service center.
I sometimes go to visit my old teacher.

explain: 찾아가다는 만날 사람이나 가야 할 곳이 정해져 있을 때 써요. 그냥 “가다”보다 일부러 가는 느낌이에요.

dict_examples.en: Pick up a bag from the baggage storage.

dict_examples.en: He came and picked up the luggage he had left with me.

explain_en: 찾아가다 is for when you have a certain person or place in mind. It feels more deliberate than just 가다.
